description: Cross-language test vector for the Noise Protocol Framework REKEY operation (spec rev 34 §11.3) under ChaChaPoly, pinning github.com/flynn/noise's CipherState.Rekey() against dissononce's Cipher.rekey(). Both sides of the agent link rekey their transport ciphers with this operation every 15 minutes; if the two implementations ever diverge the link silently stops decrypting, so both languages assert against these bytes. Consumed by apps/agent/internal/noiseconn/rekey_conformance_test.go and apps/backend/tests/test_noise_rekey_conformance.py.
rekey_definition: k' = ENCRYPT(k, 2^64-1, zerolen, zeros[32])[:32]; the nonce counter n is NOT reset

transport_message.comment: Sealed with the 3rd-generation key above at nonce 3 with empty associated data — i.e. what a cipher state that had rekeyed three times and encrypted three messages produces. The nonce is deliberately non-zero: a rekey must NOT reset n, and a receiver that reset it would fail to decrypt this.
